BL-1565 — A git_handoff addressed to the coordinator is refused at send: QA's post-land close of a PASSED ticket reaches the coordinator as a git_handoff stamped non-forwarding, Article 2.4 makes the coordinator complete it merge-only and wait for a close that never comes, and the ticket sits in active/ at cap 1 until the swarm starves (BL-1527 parcel 002673 on 09-13, BL-1563 parcel 002698 on 09-14) - the close is a note, and swarm_handoff.sh refuses the parcel shape before the mailbox
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the refusal keys on the recipient name `coordinator` and on `type: git_handoff` only - Article 1.1 names that role as the one with no code commits, and roles.tsv carries no bookkeeping-…
BL-1565 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1565" (or "reject BL-1565 <reason>") to act.
